claims.statement: Northgate Business Park sold in March 2025 for $41,000,000, equating to $276.10 per square foot.

citations.quote:
Northgate Business Park traded in March 2025 for $41,000,000 ($276.10 per square foot) at a
cap rate of approximately 6.10%

claims.statement: The transaction data workbook records the sale date as 2025-03-14, a building area of 148,500 square feet, and net operating income of $2,152,500.

The evidence gives two conflicting cap rate figures for the Northgate Business Park sale: the narrative memo states a cap rate of approximately 6.10%, while the underlying transaction workbook lists the cap rate as 5.25% for the same sale.

citations.quote:
Northgate Business Park traded in March 2025 for $41,000,000 ($276.10 per square foot) at a
cap rate of approximately 6.10%, consistent with prevailing suburban office cap rates at the
time the asset was first underwritten.
